title: Baguio, Ormoc top circular economy assessment among Green LGUs

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY – The cities of Baguio in the Cordillera and Ormoc in Leyte were named flagship local governments and top-performing project partners in circular economy initiatives under the European Union-Philippines Partnership for Green Economy’s Green LGUs Project, according to information shared by the Baguio City Public Information Office on Wednesday (October 21). The mid-term evaluation, commissioned by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) in the Philippines and conducted by independent consulting firm Artival Research & Evaluation, covered 20 city and municipal grantees from March 1, 2024, to May 31, 2026.
